sampling.title: DPI / Sampling
sampling.window: Observed during the last {minutes} minutes (up to 1 hour)
sampling.basis: Impact uses observed sample bytes, network traffic and drops. The theoretical maximum uses the current flow budget and recent flow rate. New flows are estimated from observed tuples.
sampling.privacy: Sampling captures portions of original network payload for Collector DPI in memory. Raw payload is released after analysis and is never stored, logged or returned by the API. Configure sampling on the Agent or in LuCI.

policies.desiredStageTip: The desired policy revision currently stored by the Collector.
policies.deliveredStageTip: The Collector wrote this revision snapshot to WebSocket; this does not prove the Agent received it.
policies.acknowledgedStageTip: The Agent reported receiving this revision; receipt does not mean the rules are active.
policies.appliedStageTip: The last policy revision the Agent confirmed fully applied. Partial, degraded or failed execution does not advance this revision; parts of a newer revision may already be active.

deploymentStatusHint.not_deployed: There are no policies to deliver yet. The Agent has not reported, so its runtime state is unknown.
deploymentStatusHint.offline: The Collector is not connected to the Agent, so the desired revision has not been delivered. Existing local rules may still be active.
deploymentStatusHint.pending: The Collector is waiting for the Agent to acknowledge or apply the current desired revision.
deploymentStatusHint.delivered: The Collector wrote the snapshot to WebSocket. This does not mean the Agent acknowledged it or the runtime applied it.
deploymentStatusHint.applied: The Agent reported that the runtime applied the current desired revision.
deploymentStatusHint.partial: The Agent reported partial or degraded execution. The last fully applied revision does not advance. Review each policy's status and reason.
deploymentStatusHint.degraded: The Agent reported policies running with reduced capability. Review policy states and device capabilities.
deploymentStatusHint.unsupported: The Agent or device does not support executing these policies.
deploymentStatusHint.failed: The Agent reported an application failure. Review policy states and errors below.

policies.neverShowActive: Unsupported, failed, degraded or partial execution

reasons.one_arm_icmp_redirects_enabled: One-arm forwarding is active and ICMP redirects are enabled. Clients may learn the upstream gateway and bypass this policy.
reasons.one_arm_icmp_redirects_unknown: One-arm forwarding is active, but ICMP redirect status is unknown. Clients may bypass this policy.
reasons.one_arm_client_block_degraded: One-arm blocking covers observed forwarded traffic. The upstream return path cannot be independently verified locally.
reasons.one_arm_return_path_unverified: The one-arm return path is unverified. Both traffic directions must traverse the Agent.
reasons.one_arm_redirects_unsafe: ICMP redirects must be confirmed disabled before one-arm shaping can run.
reasons.one_arm_ipv6_path_unverified: The IPv6 default gateway must be on the shared LAN interface for one-arm shaping.
reasons.unsupported_one_arm_shaping: This Agent version does not support one-arm shaping. Upgrade the Agent.
reasons.unsupported_platform: Policy enforcement is available only on Linux.
reasons.topology_unavailable: The Agent could not inspect local routes and interfaces.
reasons.unsupported_topology: The network topology or forwarding path does not meet this policy's requirements.
reasons.unsupported_offload: Flow offload is enabled and may bypass policy enforcement. Disable flow offload.
reasons.offload_unknown: The Agent could not confirm that software and hardware flow offload are disabled.
reasons.ipv6_unavailable: IPv6 coverage is incomplete. Enforcement covers only supported address families.
reasons.identity_limit_exceeded: LAN neighbor bindings exceed the policy identity limit.
reasons.identity_unresolved: No current LAN address could be resolved for a selected client.
reasons.identity_conflict: A LAN address maps to multiple clients. The Agent cannot safely identify the policy target.
reasons.identity_partial: Some selected clients lack an unambiguous LAN identity. Known clients remain shaped.
reasons.nft_unavailable: The nft command is unavailable or failed to run.
reasons.unsupported_multi_egress: Shaping requires one verified LAN interface and one verified WAN interface.
reasons.unsupported_interface_speed: Shaping requires a measured or explicitly configured interface capacity between 64 Kbps and 1 Gbps.
reasons.unsupported_kernel_feature: Required kernel shaping or classification features are unavailable or could not be verified.
reasons.unsupported_bpf_verifier: Application enforcement requires a verified BPF writer and TC hooks.
reasons.unsupported_mark_conflict: Existing packet-mark rules conflict with policy shaping, or their ownership could not be verified.
reasons.unsupported_existing_qdisc: Existing queue rules prevent safe policy shaping.
reasons.qdisc_ownership_conflict: The Agent could not verify ownership of the existing queue rules.
reasons.degraded_ownership_conflict: The shaping interface or queue layout changed. Reconcile the existing layout before applying policies.
reasons.unsupported_global_app_limit: Global application bandwidth pools are not supported. Select specific clients.
reasons.unsupported_application_shaping: Application shaping requires verified child classes and egress marks.
reasons.unsupported_policy_shape: This policy's selectors, action or network scope are not supported.
reasons.unsupported_client_limit: Interface capacity is too low for the requested client classes.
reasons.unsupported_application_limit: Interface capacity is too low for the requested application classes.
reasons.invalid_client_rate: A client rate ceiling exceeds the shared interface capacity.
reasons.emergency_disabled: Policy enforcement is disabled by the Agent's local emergency marker.
reasons.invalid_snapshot: The policy snapshot is invalid or belongs to another gateway.
reasons.local_state_invalid: The Agent's saved policy state is invalid.
reasons.invalid_local_state: The Agent could not validate its saved shaping state.
reasons.manual_cleanup_required: The previous shaping layout could not be safely recovered. Manual cleanup is required.
reasons.revision_rollback_detected: The snapshot revision is older than the last successfully saved revision.
reasons.stale_snapshot: The snapshot revision or generation is older than the last applied snapshot.
reasons.snapshot_identity_conflict: The same policy revision and generation have conflicting checksums.
reasons.state_prepare_failed: The Agent could not prepare local policy state.
reasons.state_persist_failed: The Agent could not save local policy state.
reasons.nft_apply_failed: The Agent could not apply the nftables policy rules.
reasons.nft_inspection_failed: The Agent could not verify the installed nftables policy rules.
reasons.tc_apply_failed: The Agent could not apply the traffic shaping rules.
reasons.schedule_window_missing: The scheduled policy has no compiled UTC intervals.
reasons.schedule_expired: The Collector's compiled policy schedule has expired.
reasons.clock_invalid: The Agent's system time is invalid. Correct the clock before applying scheduled policies.
reasons.agent_offline: The Collector is not connected to the Agent.
reasons.client_block_unsupported: Client blocking is not supported by this Agent or topology.
